basis: Five-route API-01 pilot extrapolated linearly to 360 runs; Daybreak uses the observed Sol pilot cost only as a planning proxy.
interpretation: Planning estimate only, not actual billed cost.

billing_status_policy.openai_codex: Record provider-reported included status; do not relabel API-equivalent cost as billed.
billing_status_policy.opencode_go: Record provider-reported unknown status unless an authoritative billed value becomes available.

stopping_rules: Do not change any frozen source, starter, grader, route, pricing snapshot, seed, timeout, reasoning level, or toolset after the first eligible v2 run starts.
Provider and grader failures remain outcomes; do not selectively rerun completed sealed artifacts.
Resume is allowed only for an incomplete run with exactly matching frozen inputs and the same run key.
Abort the campaign if freeze or grader commitments fail verification, tool sandbox activation is absent, or sealed-artifact integrity fails.
